entry_state: Zero covariance does not imply independence, and arbitrary reserve refits need not inherit variance additivity. Cost-of-capital charges require separately chosen capital, rates and payment dates. The software exchange must now retain complete draws and distinguish valid zero from failure.
exit_state: The reserving exchange preserves each fitted mean, payment, status and joint draw. Failed and pending computation cannot be recoded as zero or probability mass. Resume requires a bound checkpoint and random state; documentary examples establish no runtime durability or calibrated forecast.
findings: The complete sample mean is 15. A failed cell makes that requested mean unresolved; completed-only 18 and zero-filled 11 answer different questions.
The retained source's NA-to-zero step loses information that a wrapper around final arrays cannot recover.
Scaled Poisson and negative binomial can share mean and variance while differing in support. Seed reuse is not evidence of independent streams or a resumable checkpoint.
Cancellation retains completed draw 12 and an unattempted second draw; completion fraction is computational coverage, not financial probability. No new defect observed.
